entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Alex at VeloFit Customer Support. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex. I'd like to start a return for an order I received a couple of weeks ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?

Thank you. I see the order here for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet. It looks like it was delivered 18 days ago. To understand the situation, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the helmet or more of a preference?
It's just a matter of preference. The product itself is fine, but the color isn't what I was hoping for once I saw it in person. The box is still unopened, as I decided against it right away.

I understand completely. Let me just pull up our return policy for you. One moment... Okay, I've confirmed that for a standard item like this helmet, you are well within our 90-day return window. I can definitely approve this return for a full refund.

That's great news, thank you. I do have one question. Since I'm returning it with the box unopened and saving you some processing, and I'll be paying for the return shipping, would it be possible to get a small 10% discount code for my next VeloFit purchase?

I'm glad we could get the return sorted for you. While I can't offer a discount code for a standard preference-based return, I can assure you that you'll receive a full refund for the item's cost once it's back in our warehouse. Our main priority is making sure you have gear you trust for your personal safety on the road.
Okay, that's fair. A full refund is what's most important. Please go ahead and send me the return instructions.

Of course. I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label and instructions within the next 15 minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks for your help, Alex.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
